home.title: Ramadan Planner
home.description: Plan your Ramadan with the Ilm Institute planner. Track Quran reading, prayers, du'a, charity, and more.

planner.title: Ramadan Planner
planner.welcome: Welcome to your Ramadan {year} planner. May Allah accept your worship.

preRamadan.title: Pre-Ramadan Preparation
preRamadan.description: Prepare yourself before Ramadan. Our predecessors started 6 months in advance.
preRamadan.repentance: Ask for repentance with a sincere heart
preRamadan.dua: Make much dua (e.g. O Allah, keep me safe until Ramadan...)
preRamadan.tasksDescription: Hasten to complete tasks that may distract you from worship
preRamadan.booksDescription: Reading books about Ramadan helps develop motivation and understanding
preRamadan.missedFastsDescription: Complete any missed fasting days from the previous Ramadan (e.g. in Sha'ban)
preRamadan.shaabanDescription: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to fast most of Sha'ban
preRamadan.quranPlanPlaceholder: e.g. 1 page after every prayer, or complete Quran from where you left off
preRamadan.duaPlaceholder: e.g. O Allah, keep me safe until Ramadan, keep Ramadan safe for me, and accept it from me

quran.title: Quran
quran.description: Ramadan is the month of the Quran. Strengthen your relationship with it.
quran.juzDescription: 1 juz = 20 pages. Pace yourself and write the completed date for each juz.
quran.alKahfDescription: Whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday, Allah will bestow upon him light between those two Fridays.
quran.memorizationDescription: Choose one surah or a few short surahs to memorize. Learn tafsir each day.

prayers.title: Prayers
prayers.description: Track the five daily prayers, night prayers, Duha, and Sunnah Rawatib throughout Ramadan.
prayers.dailyDescription: Track Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha throughout Ramadan.
prayers.nightDescription: Whoever spends the nights of Ramadan in prayer out of faith and in the hope of reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.
prayers.duhaDescription: Two rak'ahs of Duha can accomplish the sadaqah for every joint in the morning.
prayers.sunnahDescription: 4 before Dhuhr, 2 after Dhuhr, 2 after Maghrib, 2 after Isha, 2 before Fajr
prayers.lastTenDescription: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. Strive hard in worship.
prayers.lastTenDua: Best dua to recite: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibb al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni (O Allah, You are forgiving and You love forgiveness, so forgive me).

dua.title: Dua & Adhkar
dua.description: Write your duas and memorize the morning & evening adhkar.
dua.listDescription: Write your duas before or early in Ramadan. Read them every night, especially on the last ten nights.
dua.adhkarDescription: Learn and memorize one adhkar each week in Ramadan.

habits.title: Habits
habits.description: Build good habits and give up bad ones this Ramadan.
habits.buildDescription: Add habits you wish to develop during Ramadan
habits.giveUpTitle: Habits I want to give up
habits.giveUpDescription: Add habits you wish to break during Ramadan

charity.title: Charity
charity.description: Whoever gives iftar to one who is fasting will have a reward like his.
charity.weeklyDescription: List charity acts for each week (e.g. send Laban for Iftar, drinks to mosque, Iftar box for the needy)
charity.iftarDescription: Plan your Iftar gatherings. Inviting others to Iftar is a recommended act of charity.
charity.childrenDescription: Educate children through charity. List acts to do with your kids each week.

children.title: Children
children.description: The best gift we can give our children is education. Take advantage of Ramadan to educate them.
children.activitiesDescription: Iftar prep (arrange table, prepare sweets/drinks), Quran reading, Tarawih together, hadith sharing (posters, stories)
